active_work_package.title: PLAN-001 part two: gates BT-G0 to BT-G7 with labels A to E, stream entry conditions, cross-cutting tracks, Definition of Done - issue #183
active_work_package.objective: Resolve ticket #156 on the Guide v2 map: extend docs/architecture/BIZTRUST-PLAN-001.md with the gate table (the previous plan's seven rows verbatim plus BT-G7 Production Ready), the executive-label mapping A to E with BT-G6 judged inside E, what each label requires, the expansion streams' entry conditions, the eight cross-cutting tracks per phase, and the Definition of Done reconciled with the guide's eight items; leave DELIVERY_PLAN.md section 7 untouched so the phase-page test's seven-gate assertion holds.

PLAN-001 now carries sections 1 to 15: the partition (part one) and the gates, labels, stream entry conditions, tracks and Definition of Done (part two). Two gate tables coexist by declaration: DELIVERY_PLAN.md section 7 with seven gates, which the manuals render and tests/test_phase_pages.py asserts exactly, and PLAN-001 section 10 with eight, the record going forward; they differ by BT-G7 and the labels only, and the overview ticket #165 retires the first. The Definition of Done stays the guide's eight items, with the roadmap's eighteen mapped beneath them and 'gate passed' excluded because gates close phases, not packages. The primary action is unchanged: NS-041, the operator's #92 waiver on #27. NS-044 now points at #157. Unchanged: NS-040 (#78), NS-024 (#93), NS-042 (#94), NS-043 (#147 on map #128), NS-033 (#52), NS-003 to NS-005 for the repository owner, the oracle author, experiment re-run NOT_GRANTED, NS-007 unticketed; #154 asks the operator for the roadmap's three cited documents.
